decision: H (panel 2026-11-19 D8, applied s25, spec decision log #195): the ledger's closure claim is withdrawn and it stays disclosure with no guarantee; no third attempt. E0b was run once on its pre-registered held-out seeds 1100-1107 and failed.

diagnosis.note: computed after the verdict from the held-out data (reported only; the verdict is unchanged): with the passive fee leg L_b*dtau_b*f_w replaced by its true value (the witness range's fee growth read after the opening and before the closing vault call, valued at the segment's p1), every resolved row closes
diagnosis.attribution: the failure is the passive leg's time-based fee rate f_w: a witness lifetime's fees are attributed to segments in proportion to credited time rather than to when they were earned, so neighbouring epochs carry large opposite-signed residuals (e.g. seed 1107: e2 +4.09 bp, e3 -3.72 bp); the vault fee leg (read from pool state), the price leg, the L_b sizing and the share terms reconcile
diagnosis.valuation_remainder: f_w values the witness fees at the lifetime's last p1 while the truth values each segment at its own p1; on the fit data this remainder is at most 0.014 bp (frozen-state review S25R-02)
diagnosis.evaluator_exceptions: none (no script reported an evaluator error; failed_scripts is empty)
diagnosis.reproducer: python3 eval/supplements/e0b_diagnosis.py <held-out data dir> (checks the numbers above)

fit.note: E0a's three scripts as fit data; exit closes by construction (the vault read is the truth's own quantity)

future_work: reading the witness's fee growth at each vault call would make the passive fee leg exact (diagnosis above); that is a different ledger outside panel D6 and is not counted toward E0, E0a or E0b
